description: Is this supplier price fair? Compares a quoted price (any currency; per t, kg, lb, unit…) with the PackIndex benchmark: difference %, verdict FAIR / HIGH / LOW, where the quote sits in the benchmark's 12-month range and, with a quantity, the overpayment. Free callers are compared with the 12-week delayed reference value.

code.description: PackIndex code, e.g. PP, KRLNR, OCC, GAS_TTF, CORR. Use search_indices if unsure.

quantity.description: Order quantity in the quote's unit

quote_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; compares with the benchmark on that date (paid plans)

region.description: Where the quote is for, e.g. 'Germany'

unit.description: Quote unit: t, kg, lb, MWh, therm, L, bbl, unit, 1000… (defaults to the benchmark's unit)

name: check_quote
title: Check a supplier quote
